name: Being Depressed
overview: Scripture reveals that those who are experiencing depression can find refuge by dwelling in the presence of God, described as abiding under the shadow of the Almighty. The Word of God serves as a guiding light in dark times, providing clarity and direction for the believer's path. Jesus promises abundant life, contrasting the destruction brought by the enemy, and assures believers of the ongoing presence of the Comforter to sustain them. Furthermore, believers can trust that God works all things together for good according to His purpose, offering hope and assurance even in difficult seasons.
